source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 30 to December 4
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 27, 2026 · 13 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Hela: of Mice & Magic Knights Peak ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Hela: of Mice & Magic – December 1Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Playing as a brave little mouse, you will journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time. Along the way, you’ll uncover deeply moving stories rooted in the lives of the land’s inhabitants. Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op. FreeStyle Football 2 JOYCITY Corp. ☆☆☆☆☆ 20 ★★★★★ Get it now FreeStyle Football 2 – December 3Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere FreeStyle Football 2 is an online multiplayer football game featuring 5v5 matches with unique character roles and skills. Compete in 5v5 online matches with a colorful cast of characters, feel the action through immersive controller feedback and compete across iconic global pitches. DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $59.99 Pre-order DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World – December 3XBOX Play Anywhere In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime. Early Purchase Bonus: Adventure Starter Set Rayman Legends Retold Ubisoft ☆☆☆☆☆ 30 ★★★★★ Get it now Rayman Legends Retold – December 3 Embark on a bold reimagining of the acclaimed platformer, filled with new content and narrative twists. When a shadowy villain spreads corruption across the Glade of Dreams, journey through its charming worlds solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op in a fast‑paced, side‑scrolling adventure where every stumble and surprise adds to the delightful chaos. Pre-order any edition of Rayman Legends Retold and receive the exclusive Hoodlum Havoc Pack, containing 2 costumes for Rayman and Globox inspired by Rayman 3: Hoodlum Havoc. Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition Ubisoft ☆☆☆☆☆ 24 ★★★★★ Get it now Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition – December 3 When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream. Work together, compete for rewards, and turn every level into a shared, unforgettable adventure, as you play in up to 4-player couch co-op. Thief: The Dark Project Remastered Atari ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $29.99 Pre-order Thief: The Dark Project Remastered – December 3Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. Thief was the first stealth game to use light and sound as game mechanics to help you hide from and sneak up on characters, rather than simply attacking them. Dumpster Gang Curve Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Dumpster Gang – December 3 Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars. Sprint, climb walls, crawl through vents, and reach places only a raccoon could. Pick up, throw, steal, or smash nearly everything you find and turn every level into your own chaotic playground. The aMAZEing Labyrinth Markt+Technik Verlag GmbH ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $14.99 Pre-order The aMAZEing Labyrinth – November 30Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere In search of mysterious objects and creatures, players roam the labyrinth as a magician, witch, fortune teller and sorcerer’s apprentice. Whoever finds the way first wins. Luckily, they can use magic to move the walls of the maze. On the way through constantly changing paths, however, each player must first reach secret locations. The mystery cards reveal whether the next target is a ghost, a bunch of keys, an owl or something else. The first to discover all the secrets and return to their starting point is the winner. The random arrangement of the maze cards makes each game different. Endless fun guaranteed! Winx Club – Moonlight Quest BALIO STUDIO S.R.L ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $39.99 $33.99 Pre-order Winx Club – Moonlight Quest – November 30Smart Delivery Fly into a brand-new adventure in the Winx Club universe! Play as Bloom and dive into a magical world inspired by the series, full of iconic locations, mysteries and secrets to discover. The Magic Dimension awaits. Transform, take flight and write a brand new Winx adventure! Cloudberry Kingdom RedoApps Ltd ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $14.99 Pre-order Cloudberry Kingdom – December 1 In Cloudberry Kingdom, the beloved platformer returns, now available on modern consoles. Dive into a world where every jump, jetpack boost, and wheelie roll feels fresh yet comfortingly familiar. Meet Bob, the courageous hero of Cloudberry Kingdom. When King Kobbler threatens to throw the kingdom into chaos, Bob steps up to protect his home. With the princess in danger and the future of the realm at stake, Bob sets out on a daring adventure to restore peace. The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] PolyCrunch Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $14.99 Pre-order The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] – December 1S

Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires eligible Game Pass plan.DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionWhen the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune. For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, as the world begins to fall out of harmony, the witch who has always protected it is growing ill. Her tiniest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety. Playing as a brave little mouse, you will journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time. Along the way, you’ll uncover deeply moving stories rooted in the lives of the land’s inhabitants. Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op. CARRY HER KINDNESS INTO THE WILD The witch has spent her life caring for the world around her. Now, it’s your turn to care for her by continuing the work she can no longer carry alone. Gather ingredients and brew magical remedies, using their special properties to solve playful environmental puzzles and lend a helping paw to animals and communities throughout the land. Each small act brings you closer to restoring harmony to the land and helping the witch who has long cared for you and all the forest’s inhabitants. SEE THE WORLD THROUGH TINY EYES Travel through a lovingly crafted playground inspired by the landscapes of Northern Sweden, from rugged mountain trails and magical forests to tranquil lakes and misty wetlands. To a mouse, even familiar places become enormous. Everyday objects become obstacles, useful tools, and invitations to play, while hidden paths and story fragments reward those who pause, listen, and look a little closer. Glide through the air, climb to new heights, experiment with the world around you, and find your own way through an adventure filled with quiet wonder. SHARE THE JOURNEY Some adventures are meant to be shared. Experience the full adventure solo, with a friend in local split-screen, or in online co-op for up to four players. Work together to explore the landscape, overcome challenges, and discover playful solutions. When you play solo, the Shade System lets you create magical copies of yourself to assist with puzzles and interact with the world, ensuring that every part of the journey remains open to you. MEET FROGGY Your magical Froggy backpack is more than just a useful tool: it’s your constant companion on the road ahead. Use Froggy to leap, swing, glide, gather resources, interact with the environment, and solve puzzles. As your journey continues, you will discover new ways for Froggy to help you reach hidden places and navigate a world built for curiosity.Show morePublished byKnights PeakDeveloped byWindupPlay withXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilitiesXbox local co-op (2-2)Online co-op (2-4)Xbox cross-platform multiplayer4K Ultra HDHDR10Single playerShared/split screenXbox cross-platform co-op60 fps+Optimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox presenceXbox cloud savesXbox Play AnywhereComing to these subscriptionsPC onlyUltimate XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) You
